    # When set, the pattern is matched segment by segment so a star stays within one directory.
    per_segment: bool = False

def _route_matches(path: str, route: PublicRoute) -> bool:

def test_default_badge_route_does_not_expose_nested_folders():
    service = AssetService({"/teams/west/drafts/badge.png": b"draft", "/teams/west/badge.png": b"PNG"})

    service = AssetService({"/partners/a/b/logo.png": b"PNG"}, routes=(PublicRoute("/partners/*/logo.png"),))
